title: Typhoon Queenie may exit PAR Sunday – Pagasa
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Queenie (international name: Surigae) is forecast to exit the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Sunday noon or afternoon, according to the state weather bureau.…
